purpose: Define pre-deployment verification of target environment, dependencies, capacity, secrets, configuration, migrations, entitlements and health prerequisites before effectful rollout.

topics.name: Deployment Preflight
topics.purpose: Define pre-deployment verification of target environment, dependencies, capacity, secrets, configuration, migrations, entitlements and health prerequisites before effectful rollout.

semantics.stale_rule: Materially changed target state after preflight may require revalidation.
semantics.authority_rule: Preflight pass grants no deployment authority by itself.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: secret missing discovered after destructive migration begins
target changed but old preflight reused
